zh: 你是不是有空，一起下班喝杯咖啡？
old_en: Would you like to have coffee with me after work?
new_en: Do you have time to have coffee with me after work?

zh: 这周六我过生日，想请你们来参加聚会。
old_en: Would you like to come to my birthday party this Saturday?
new_en: I'm having a birthday party this Saturday. Would you like to come?

zh: 你明天有空吗，一起去参加朋友的生日派对？
old_en: Are you free tomorrow to go to your friend's birthday party?
new_en: Are you free tomorrow to go to a friend's birthday party with me?

zh: 最近有部新电影，你想不想一起去看？
old_en: Do you want to see the new movie with me recently?
new_en: There's a new movie. Would you like to see it with me?

zh: 你周末想不想和我一起看电影？
old_en: Would you like to watch a movie with me this weekend?
new_en: Would you like to watch a movie with me this weekend?

zh: 你今天有空吗，一起去新展厅看看？
old_en: Are you free today to go to the new exhibition with me?
new_en: Are you free today to go to a new exhibition with me?

zh: 你周末有空吗，一起参观新展厅吧？
old_en: Do you want to visit the new exhibition with me this weekend?
new_en: Are you free this weekend to visit a new exhibition with me?

zh: 你是不是有空，一起参加婚礼？
old_en: Are you free today evening, to go for a run in the park?
new_en: Are you free to go to a wedding with me?

zh: 下个月全家一起去旅行，你要不要一起？
old_en: Would you like to go on a trip with us next month?
new_en: Would you like to join our family trip next month?

zh: 你下班后要不要一起喝一杯？
old_en: Are you free after work to grab a drink together?
new_en: Want to grab a drink together after work?

zh: 你周末有空吗，一起来家里吃饭吧？
old_en: Are you free this weekend? Let's have dinner at my place.
new_en: You free this weekend? Come over for dinner.

zh: 你周末想不想来我家吃饭？
old_en: Are you free this weekend to come over for dinner?
new_en: Want to come over for dinner this weekend?

zh: 周六下午，我家孩子想请你家孩子一起玩，好不好？
old_en: Are you free this Saturday afternoon to play with my child?
new_en: This Saturday afternoon, my kid wants to play with yours, how about it?

zh: 周末要不要让你家孩子来我们家玩？
old_en: Are you free to let your child come to our place this weekend?
new_en: Want to let your kid come over to play this weekend?

zh: 婚礼那天你有空吗，一起参加？
old_en: Are you free on the wedding day, would you like to join us?
new_en: Free on the wedding day? Join us, okay?

zh: 你周末有空吗，一起晨跑吧？
old_en: Are you free this weekend? Would you like to go for a morning run together?
new_en: You free this weekend? Want to go for a morning run together?

zh: 你今天晚上有空吗，一起去公园晨跑？
old_en: Are you free today evening? Would you like to go for a morning run in the park together?
new_en: Are you free this evening? Want to go for a morning run in the park together?

zh: 周五晚上我们有个读书会，你要不要来参加？
old_en: Would you like to come to our reading club this Friday evening?
new_en: We have a reading club this Friday evening. Want to join us?

zh: 这个月的读书会，你有兴趣参加吗？
old_en: Are you free to join this month's book club?
new_en: This month's book club is coming up. Are you interested in joining?

zh: 这个假期我们全家去旅行，你想不想一起来？
old_en: Would you like to join us for a trip during this holiday?
new_en: We're going on a family trip this holiday. Want to come along?
